Name: Tree of Knowledge
Author: TheMightyAmondee
Description:
[size=5][b]Tree of Knowledge[/b][/size]

This mod adds a magical tree to the bus stop area that will display player stats when interacted with. Stats include general stats, monsters killed counters and farm animal data.


[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
1. Ensure all required mods as listed are installed.
﻿This mod requires:
﻿﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 3.14.0 or above
﻿﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 1.23.0 or above
﻿ ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7517]Custom Tokens[/url] 1.5.1 or above
﻿﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9659]Stats as Tokens[/url] 0.5.4 or above
2. Download the mod
3. Extract the contents of the zip download into the Mods folder
4. Enjoy!

[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
﻿- Tree of Knowledge is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.6
﻿- Multiplayer and split-screen is mostly supported, see limitations below
﻿- Compatible with Ridgeside Village, East Scarp and Stardew Valley Expanded

[b][size=4]Known limitations:[/size][/b]
This mod works best with new saves. Some existing save stats may be inaccurate. Known inaccuracies are listed below:

﻿- The deepest volcano floor and pass out count stat will only be accurate from the time Custom Tokens is downloaded in existing saves.
- ﻿If the amount of ostrish eggs or trash cans checked is 0, no stat is displayed. This is a limitation of Stats as Tokens.
﻿- Some stats in multiplayer may be inaccurate. This is also a Stats as Tokens limitation.
